column3: Reduce motion is a System/On select in Settings › General beside Theme, stored in localStorage ingle.motion and applied before first paint in index.html; there is no Off
column4: ingle-motion.css applies its prefers-reduced-motion block unconditionally and defines only :root[data-motion="reduce"], so an Off that overrides the OS has nothing to switch; the v5 build has no Appearance page, and the theme control it would sit beside lives in General
